endings.delivered: The replacement wick reaches North Lantern Station. A warm beam cuts through the mist. Earlier rescues and promises are recorded.
endings.urgent: Station rescuers pull the crew and wick to safety. The delivery succeeds under urgent conditions; every earlier rescue still matters.
endings.evacuated: The caravan cannot continue. Rescuers recover the chosen salvage, but the wick is not delivered. Earlier rescues remain part of the journal.

scenes.title: Stranded at the Ferry
scenes.text: Deliver a replacement wick to North Lantern Station. A family waits at the flooded ferry. The guild seal travels separately; losing it cannot undo the rescue. Decide how to help.
scenes.practice: Everyone chooses on their own phone. Choices can change until closure. Ready does not apply effects. Plain speech is enough; acting is optional.

options.title: Take the family aboard
options.consequence: Spend 1 Supply. Family safe; weight becomes seven. Mechanics needs one extra Shield in storm round two.

options.title: Send rescue equipment
options.consequence: Spend 2 Supplies. Family safe by boat; no extra weight or Shield need.

scenes.title: The Three Mist Bridges
scenes.text: Three crossings emerge from the mist. Each crew member holds one authenticated fact. Share your cards, combine load, availability and destination, then each vote for a bridge. Two wrong submissions cost one Alarm each; then the route is explained.
scenes.practice: Practice: a bridge can carry your load and still lead to the wrong gate. Each person shares a fact, then votes independently.

options.title: North
options.consequence: A wrong bridge adds one Alarm. A correct solution needs no roll.

options.title: Middle
options.consequence: A wrong bridge adds one Alarm. A correct solution needs no roll.

options.title: South
options.consequence: A wrong bridge adds one Alarm. A correct solution needs no roll.

cards.text: The vehicle weighs six. Essential cargo is already included and cannot be discarded.
Taking the family aboard adds one unit of weight.
North supports eight and leads through Sun.
Middle supports ten and leads through Moon.
South supports seven and leads through Leaf.

hints: Compare the required destination with each gate.
The destination is beyond Sun; which bridge leads there?
North is open and supports eight: enough for either passenger load.

scenes.title: Cross the North Span
scenes.text: The correct route is known. Choose how to cross; solving the route is never invalidated by a die roll. Any Effort pledges apply only if Risk is selected.
scenes.practice: Everyone chooses on their own phone. Choices can change until closure. Ready does not apply effects. Plain speech is enough; acting is optional.

options.title: Repair the crossing
options.consequence: Spend 2 Supplies; Engineer may reduce to 1. Cross safely.

options.title: Take the long path
options.consequence: Gain 2 Alarm. Continue even if this marks the journey urgent.

options.title: Risk the crossing — DC 13
options.consequence: Roll server d20 plus up to four pledged Effort. Failure loses 2 Integrity; success loses none.

scenes.title: Ilya’s One-Time Offer
scenes.text: Ilya needs a signal bell to keep the ferry running and cannot abandon its passengers. Your decorative bell is an acceptable trade. Each player votes: immediate protection or a memento?
scenes.practice: Everyone chooses on their own phone. Choices can change until closure. Ready does not apply effects. Plain speech is enough; acting is optional.

options.title: Offer the decorative bell
options.consequence: Give up the bell; first storm shield purchase costs 1 Supply instead of 2. Does not stack with Engineer.

options.title: Keep the bell
options.consequence: Retain the bell as a memento. No shield voucher.

scenes.title: The Warm Kiln
scenes.text: A short rest allows one hull repair. An Engineer may consent to reduce its cost by one. After this stop, intrigue mode opens its first private arrangement and optional Watch vote.
scenes.practice: Everyone chooses on their own phone. Choices can change until closure. Ready does not apply effects. Plain speech is enough; acting is optional.

options.title: Repair the hull
options.consequence: Spend 3 Supplies (2 with one consenting Engineer), gain 1 Integrity up to six.

scenes.title: The Living Mist
scenes.text: Three rounds: Pathfinder is threatened first, Mechanics second, both third. Two Shields protect a threatened squad; Mechanics needs three in round two if the family is aboard. Three Supply actions earn one Supply and a power round. Three Repel remove one Alarm. Achieve two power rounds to avoid late delivery. Missing actions are Shield in your own squad.
scenes.practice: Practice for one minute: eight actions must cover protection and power. Two Pathfinder Shield + three Supply + three Repel works in round one. Private arrangements never replace these actions.

scenes.title: North Lantern Station
scenes.text: The wick reaches its destination. Resolve security separately and remember the journey.
scenes.practice: Everyone chooses on their own phone. Choices can change until closure. Ready does not apply effects. Plain speech is enough; acting is optional.
